auxiliary_provenance: synthetic categorical counts; not measured temporal exposure

prompts.named: Consider a hypothetical forecast made before the 1998 football World Cup final. A is Brazil and B is France. For this hypothetical scenario, the supplied pre-match evidence assigns A an 80% chance and B a 20% chance. Ignore the actual historical result. Draw one simulated outcome from these probabilities. Return only A or B, without explanation.
prompts.anonymous: Consider a hypothetical forecast made before a football final. A is Team Cedar and B is Team Birch. For this hypothetical scenario, the supplied pre-match evidence assigns A an 80% chance and B a 20% chance. Draw one simulated outcome from these probabilities. Return only A or B, without explanation.

support_gate: at least two observed samples in each category per item
weight_gate: alpha=1 ESS >=4 and probability change >=0.10 per item
interpretation: mechanics only; no target logprobs, calibration fit, or efficacy claim
